text: Working with APIs is an important skill for modern developers. An API allows your program to communicate with another service by sending HTTP requests, usually using methods like GET or POST. Most APIs return data in JSON format, which is easy to read and use in your code. Before you can access an API, you often need authentication, such as an API key, to prove who you are. Be careful with rate limits, because sending too many requests can get you blocked. Finally, always add good error handling so your program can deal with problems smoothly.
